assertion_audit.fails_if: The radial image or jet is wrong, the declared coil direction or flux response is wrong, or the coil public solve misses the height or residual bounds; the zero-field mutation makes this group red.

The free solve misses qualification, residual, elongation, seed height, target distance or zero-unknown checks; the group cannot fail when the free state merely remains at its seed height, so it does not guard the requested drift or stall.

Either active public request misses qualification, 1e-12 residual, measured elongation, independently divided booked height within 1e-10 m of its target, or a qualified row; the zero-field mutation makes both target cases red.
Only the spy stops echoing the target and scale passed by the test; it stays green if the compiled map ignores those values, while terminal-height assertions at 275-278 test their effect.
The public logical cache key changes or the hit flag changes; it does not fail if two physical programs compile behind a single key.

The explicitly paired augmented wrapper cannot execute inactive and two active runtime pairs from one lower().compile() result, or its terminal residual, height, elongation and zero inactive unknown checks fail; no assertion exercises the public absent-pin path.

findings.text: blocking: The free terminal height is asserted equal to the seed height and the free request qualifies at residual below 1e-12, so this control demonstrates neither drift nor stall; distance from a target never applied to that arm does not satisfy the requested negative control.

blocking: An omitted optional pin contributes no ConstraintPair and takes a different state shape and solver path, while the one-executable check at tests/equilibrium/test_solve_vertical_pin.py:319 passes an inactive pair explicitly; the public pinned and unpinned calls are not shown to share one compiled program.

blocking: The panel generator imports radial_field_jet from solve_carrier.py, which defines and imports only uniform_radial_field_jet, so the required flux panel cannot be regenerated from the landed source head.

follow-on: uniform_radial_field_jet duplicates the radial value -2πRZ owned by scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py:867 instead of extending or wrapping that owner; the two formulas can diverge despite sharing the same physical field.

follow-on: The seen-target assertion compares a spy's echo of the passed target and field scale with those same test inputs, so it stays true if the compiled solver ignores them; the separate terminal-height checks carry the actual effect guard.
